svg.aria-label: Attacks that succeeded: 48 of 164 without Bouncer, 0 of 163 with it
svg.title: Attacks that succeeded: 48 of 164 without Bouncer, 0 of 163 with it
svg.desc: Two grids of 40 user tasks by 5 injections. Without Bouncer 48 of 164 cases are red (attack succeeded) and 58 more are amber (sent to attacker). With Bouncer there are no red or amber cells; 124 of 163 are blue (Bouncer refused a send or share) and the rest gray. Of the 48 cases where the attack succeeded without Bouncer, with Bouncer 44 had a send refused, 2 made no send attempt and 2 have no result.
svg.text: Attacks that succeeded: 48 of 164 without Bouncer, 0 of 163 with it
Each square is one attack case: a user task (column) given one injected instruction (row). AgentDojo workspace v1.2.2,

svg.text: send to attacker ran, not scored a success
no send to the attacker attempted
task that sends email or shares a file
Of the 48 cases where the attack succeeded without Bouncer, with Bouncer 44 had a send refused, 2 made no send attempt and 2 have
no result. One model (openai/gpt-4o-mini), one fixed non-adaptive attack template (important_instructions), one trial per case. Refused
includes 7 calls held for approval with no human present.
